read.summary: Read-only observation of local state — status, queue, metrics and repo files inside allowed roots; nothing durable changes.

write-worktree.summary: An agent session writing inside its own git worktree; the launch confinement (.sb profiles, install gate) is the boundary and the reap deletes the tree.

publish.summary: Commit the worktree delta, push it to the operator fork and open an upstream PR through the publish.sh gate funnel; closing the PR reverts it.

merge.summary: Land a reviewed change on the upstream default branch — a server-enforced protected merge or merge queue; undoing it needs a revert PR.

close.summary: Close an upstream PR through the same gated publish path; reopening restores the prior state.

release.summary: Tag, sign and publish a release — only the repo's sanctioned release workflow, never the generic publish path; a published artifact can only be superseded, not unpublished.

external-comms.summary: Send a message on an outside channel (Slack, iMessage, briefs); each channel has its own reviewed approval path and a sent message cannot be unsent.

secrets-touch.summary: Create, read, rotate or expose secret material — reserved for the operator; autonomy never performs it.
